name: Digital Office Management Engine
subtitle: Enterprise ERP System
description: A comprehensive enterprise ERP platform developed for Visole employees to centralize daily business operations including business analytics, HR, recruitment, CRM, supply chain, sales forecasting, inventory, travel reporting, and administration.

modules.title: Business Module
items: Sales statistics by principal, customer, and item.

modules.title: Travel and Visit Reporting Module
items: Allows sales personnel to submit visit reports.
Allows management to monitor field activities and reporting records.

modules.title: Automated Resume Processing
items: Extracts candidate information from uploaded CVs.

modules.title: Sales Forecast Dashboard
items: Forecast creation against specific customers and items.
Supports demand planning and business decision-making.

name: Nexify HR
subtitle: HR Automation SaaS Platform
description: An end-to-end SaaS application that automates major HR workflows including candidate screening, CV parsing, interview scheduling, employee performance management, and wellness.
features: Extraction of candidate skills, education, and experience.
Secure meeting links for remote interviews.
Analytics dashboards for managers and HR teams.

name: Advanced Billing System
subtitle: Electricity Billing Management Application
description: A Java-based electricity billing system designed to automate electricity bill calculations, electricity usage tracking, billing history management, and invoice generation.
features: Java file handling for storing and retrieving user information.
